en: Sorry! (you bump someone's elbow on the bus)
why: A small bump gets the light word, perdón.

en: I'm so sorry about your father, Rosa.
es: Lo siento mucho por tu papá, Rosa.
why: Real loss needs the heavy word, lo siento mucho.

en: Excuse me, could you tell me the time? (to a stranger)
why: Getting a stranger's attention takes disculpe.

en: I'm sorry, Don Hernando, the bank did not approve the loan.
es: Lo siento, Don Hernando, el banco no aprobó el préstamo.

en: Sorry, I almost hit you with my bag. (to a stranger, usted)
es: Disculpe, casi lo golpeo con mi maleta.
why: A small slip with a stranger is disculpe.

en: I'm so sorry about your dog, Vale.
es: Lo siento mucho por tu perro, Vale.
why: A loss is lo siento mucho.

en: I'm sorry to bother you with this. (to a friend)
why: Siento plus a dictionary form names what you regret.

en: Excuse me, may I get by? (on a crowded bus)
